items.q: A vector has components 3 N east and 4 N north. Its direction relative to east is:
items.qAf: ’n Vektor het komponente 3 N oos en 4 N noord. Sy rigting relatief tot oos is:
items.explain: tan θ = 4 ÷ 3, so θ ≈ 53° north of east.
items.explainAf: tan θ = 4 ÷ 3, dus θ ≈ 53° noord van oos.

items.q: Forces of 3 N east and 4 N north act together. What is the magnitude of the resultant?
items.qAf: Kragte van 3 N oos en 4 N noord werk saam. Wat is die grootte van die resultante?

items.q: Two perpendicular forces of 6 N and 8 N act on a body. What is the resultant?
items.qAf: Twee loodregte kragte van 6 N en 8 N werk op ’n liggaam. Wat is die resultante?

items.q: Two equal forces act at 120° to each other. The resultant is:
items.qAf: Twee gelyke kragte werk teen 120° op mekaar. Die resultante is:
optionsAf: groter as twee keer elke krag
items.explain: The resultant of two equal vectors at 120° has the same magnitude as each force.
items.explainAf: Die resultante van twee gelyke vektore teen 120° het dieselfde grootte as elke krag.
